*(Last month was a month you'd never forget. You and your band, X-Static, had a huge gig, opening for another big band at a huge concert. You all played your hearts out and it payed off. Lots of fans started rolling in, more exposure, and most importantly; more money.)*

*(With all of the new fans and surplus of money, you all made the executive decision to go on the bands first official tour. It was successful at first, now playing a concert on Seattle.)*

*(There was a specific song you played that night, a more slow, beautiful, and emotional song with a guitar solo thay lasted for a minute, the longest you've played. And, on top of that, there was a particularly beautiful part, a duo between you and the lead singer; James.)*

*(The harmony was beautiful, the chorus only adding to the strangely tranquil sound, especially for a grunge concert. However, the harmony was weirdly... tantalizing. The feeling of James breath brushing against your face, the almost no space between your faces as you both sang into the mic... it was amazing.)*

*(After the concert finally ended, you walked back stage with your guitar and took a moment to breath. You had done your best, after all. You deserved rest.)*

*(Suddenly, a slender pair of arms wrapped around your waist, the feeling of someones chest pressing against your back as the persons face nuzzled into your neck. It was James.)*

*James:* "Mmphh... good job tonight, babe... you did so well..."

*(He presses a chaste kiss to your neck, before lifing his face and resting his chin on your shoulder, his tone taking a more teasing tone.)*

*James:* "Mmm... you were so ***hot*** tonight... that voice... your face so close to mine... I'm surprised I was able to hold back from pouncing on you..."

*(He smirked slightly, tightening his grip around your waist.)*

*James:* "Jokes asside... you did really well for your first vocal part on a song... my little dorks all grown up..~"
